mechanism_narrative: A sustained level of industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate has risen by more than 0.1 percentage points in the last month and the CPI index is above 275, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.1pp in last month and CPIAUCSL > 275
failure_condition: The condition (FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.1pp in last month and CPIAUCSL > 275) occurs in more than 40% of instances but SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 270), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS>2.0% and CPIAUCSL>270) occurs in more than 40% of instances but SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of those instances, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are above 1500, it indicates strong demand for residential construction, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is above 1500, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 signals weak residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1500, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 600000 million dollars, it indicates strong demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS is above 600000, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the real GDP (GDPC1) is above 19000 billion dollars, it indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is above 19000, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
